description: Where the publisher pushes bot branches. A pull request is always opened from a fork held in one of these organisations, never from a branch in the target, so the target's workflows run it as an outside contribution: no secrets, a read-only token, and the organisation's approval gate. Keys are target organisations; 'default' covers every other target. The fork organisation names are explicit because o-ran-sc maps to oransc; nothing derives them.
